paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构照顾者回忆与孩子共同选择拼图活动时，看见孩子转向另一项活动，之后又听到孩子请重复一步说明。两条行动可以分别描述，却不能说明孩子故意不听、没有努力或理解停止。照顾者没看见的另一场合继续未知，不用印象补齐。这个例子不要求重做拼图、加难说明或让孩子演示注意力。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a caregiver recalls a child moving from a jointly chosen puzzle activity and later asking for one instruction again. These actions can be described separately without inferring deliberate inattention, lack of effort or stopped understanding. An occasion the caregiver did not observe stays unknown rather than being filled from an impression. The scene requests no repeated puzzle, harder instruction or demonstration of attention.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡可以只谈虚构例子：“我亲眼看见或亲耳听见什么”“活动的约定是否清楚”“哪些部分我不知道”。不必交出孩子身份或个人记录，听者也不靠类别多少评价孩子或照顾者。真实发展顾虑可以向合适专业人士讨论，不需先再次观察或达到条数。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card can distinguish what was personally seen or heard, whether the activity agreement was clear and what remains unknown in the fictional scene. No child identity or personal record is needed; a listener need not judge child or caregiver by counts. Actual developmental concerns can be discussed with an appropriate professional without another observation or threshold.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不要求儿童参与练习。原20条、四份各五条的六类记录保持不变，未直接观察、无机会、回忆不清与保留回答维持未计分，不变成没有观察到。正向行动与困难不反向、不合分，不作儿童分数、常模比较或诊断。四周只提示回忆，独立验证与中英文等值尚未建立；全文无需作答，支持不设计数门槛。公开分享只含标题与入口，不含回答、计数或儿童私人信息。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and discussion cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, without involving a child in practice. The twenty descriptions and four six-category records of five remain unchanged. No direct observation, no opportunity, unclear recall and withholding stay unscored rather than becoming did not observe. Positive actions and difficulties are neither reversed nor combined into a child score, norm comparison or diagnosis. Four weeks is a recall aid, without independent validation or established English–Chinese equivalence. Full guides require no answers and support has no count threshold. Public sharing contains only the title and entry, without answers, counts or private child information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构照顾者回忆孩子在一项共同手工活动中换了坐姿，也在身体活动时继续参与；另一个片刻选择了本来提供的休息。动作与参与可以并存，不能由此判断休息有效、孩子自制好坏或应该坐多久。指南不了解舒适度与场景要求，也不要求保持不动、撤掉调整或制造不适来比较。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a caregiver recalls a child changing position during a shared craft activity, continuing while moving and choosing an already offered break on another occasion. Movement and participation can coexist without proving break effectiveness, grading self-control or deciding how long sitting should last. The guide knows neither comfort nor setting requirements and requests no stillness, removed adjustment or manufactured discomfort for comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡把“可见动作”“是否仍在参与”“当时本来有哪些支持”分开，可以只读虚构材料。不把动得少当成更好的答案，也不让听者拿本记录作管教依据。真实场合按实际需要保留已有调整，卡片不指定儿童应该怎样动或怎样停。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates visible movement, continued participation and support already available. Read the fictional material without treating less movement as a better answer or using the record as a discipline rule. Existing adjustments remain tied to actual needs; the card prescribes no way for a child to move or stop.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构照顾者回忆一项共用画笔的活动中，孩子在轮到之前伸手，也问过什么时候轮到自己。两条描述都可保留，不把询问当成抵消前一动作的好行为分。照顾者不确定顺序说明是否被理解，指南也无法判断礼貌、意图或规则公平；不要求重玩、增加等待或奖惩某个类别。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a caregiver recalls a child reaching before a turn during shared painting and also asking when the turn would come. Both descriptions can remain; the question earns no good-behaviour points to cancel the earlier action. Whether the order was understood stays uncertain. The guide judges neither politeness, intention nor fairness and requests no repeated game, longer wait or reward or penalty for a category.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡只区分“亲自听见或看见的行动”“约定过的顺序”“未核实的理解”。可以讨论虚构例子，不让孩子解释、表演或证明服从。听者不依据计数给孩子贴冲动标签、比较同龄人或安排管教；实际顾虑可以独立于网页记录被认真讨论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card distinguishes personally heard or seen actions, an agreed order and understanding not verified. Discuss the fictional scene without asking a child to explain, perform or prove obedience. A listener need not infer impulsivity, compare peers or prescribe discipline from counts. Actual concerns can be discussed independently of the webpage record.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构照顾者记得在家中看见孩子向在场成年人求助，也看见一次暂停后回到活动；对于自己不在场的学校情境，他仍然不知道。已有帮助与返回活动可以描述，却不能证明哪种帮助有效或孩子在其他地方同样如此。指南不把转述填入直接观察，也不要求收集报告、儿童文件或安排新测试。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a caregiver recalls seeing a child ask an available adult for help at home and return after a pause, while a school setting the caregiver did not attend remains unknown. Help and a return can be described without proving effectiveness or the same pattern elsewhere. The guide fills no direct observation with secondhand reports and requests no school report, child document or new test.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡可以只说明“我在场的情境”“我实际看到的支持”“我没观察到的地方”。可以只读虚构卡，不收集孩子姓名、年龄、学校或病史。专业评估可以有适当的多方信息，但本页仍只记录答题者直接观察，不用计数选择支持、改变照护或评价养育质量。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card can name the fictional setting attended, support actually seen and settings not observed. Read without collecting a child’s name, age, school or medical history. A professional assessment may consider appropriate information from multiple people, while this page still records only the respondent’s direct observations. Counts choose no support, care change or parenting verdict.
